decisions.why: AEROPLAST Sensitive Silicone dressings are advanced wound dressings; waterproof island film dressings are IV/film dressings; categories include eye wash and wound irrigation (debridement)
Division includes Sharps Disposal Containers, Nitrile Examination Gloves, and Face Masks for infection prevention and PPE
AEROKIT MODULATOR and AEROKit Series products are first aid kits for workplace and home use
MINDRAY L1/L2 defibrillators are AED devices and capital equipment; categories include defibrillation consumables (pads)
AeroLearn CPR Manikins, training masks, and haemostatic/IO training devices are CPR and resuscitation training equipment and accessories
